facts.fact: ANLC/TI-Niger says Ordinance no. 2011-22 of 26 February 2011, the charter on access to public information and administrative documents, was adopted nearly fifteen years ago and its implementation is limited.
facts.system: Ordonnance n°2011-22 portant charte d'accès à l'information publique et aux documents administratifs

facts.fact: ANLC/TI-Niger says the implementing decree of the 2011 access to information ordinance has still not been adopted.
facts.system: Ordonnance n°2011-22 portant charte d'accès à l'information publique et aux documents administratifs

systems.system: Ordonnance n°2011-22 portant charte d'accès à l'information publique et aux documents administratifs

facts.fact: The document says Ordinance no. 2024-28 of 7 June 2024 amending the cybercrime law was adopted and is used repressively against journalists and activists.
facts.system: Ordonnance n°2024-28 du 7 juin 2024 modifiant la loi sur la cybercriminalité

NER.note: The document says nothing on a data protection law.
No online consultation or channel is stated.

facts.fact: At a Niamey workshop of ANLC/TI-Niger and TI-DS with ministries, civil society and media, participants criticised the non-adoption of the 2011 access to information ordinance's implementing decree and voiced concern at the repressive use of the 2024 cybercrime ordinance.

NER.note: The workshop concerns an access to information ordinance, not a named digital law put to outside views.
